content: Aizer Health Adult & Internal Medicine Department Contact Directory & Locations: Department Phone: 845-782-3242. Department Fax: 855-592-1423. Medical Records & Proof of Address Letters: medicalrecords@aizerhealth.org (Contact: Arwa 'Amy' Adel at Ext. 2100). Locations: 1) Forest Rd (49 Forest Rd, 2nd Floor): Dr. Neil Shinder (Tue-Fri) and all Specialty Providers (Cardiology, Dermatology, Pain Management, Sleep, Nutrition). 2) Bakertown (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor): Adam Tilson PA, Naftali Minzer PA, Myer Gurkov PA, and Dr. Neil Shinder (Sundays only).

CORE SCHEDULING RULE: Standard adult medicine visit duration is 15 minutes. However, for patients aged 65+, chronic patients flagged on billing alert, or patients with a long problem list, the standard visit duration is a mandatory 30 minutes.

Primary Care Provider: Adam Tilson, PA (Physician Assistant). Location & Schedule: Bakertown (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor), Monday - Thursday (Fridays: Admin only). Strict Scheduling Rules & Limitations: Most popular provider; booked several months in advance. AGE RESTRICTION: Does NOT see new patients over 60-65 years old (due to panel capacity and follow-up constraints); this applies even if the patient is established with the clinic but new to him. Default provider on nurse schedule for Flu Shots (Mon-Thu 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM).

Primary Care Provider: Naftali Minzer, PA (Physician Assistant). Location & Schedule: Bakertown (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor), Monday - Thursday, and Alternating Sundays & Fridays. Strict Scheduling Rules & Limitations: Commercial Driver's License (CDL) Exams: Limited to two per day (1 morning, 1 afternoon), always 30 minutes. Lap Band Adjustments: Authorized for bariatric patients (maximum 2 per day).

Primary Care Provider: Myer Gurkov, PA (Physician Assistant). Location & Schedule: Bakertown (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor), Monday - Thursday, and Alternating Sundays & Fridays. Strict Scheduling Rules & Limitations: Handles high volume of chronic patients (including Hamaspik and RAYIM). Saturday night shifts are for urgent care only (NOT pre-booked). NO CDL / NO LAP BAND: Does NOT perform CDL exams or lap band adjustments.

Primary Care Provider: Dr. Neil Shinder, MD (Sole Primary Medical Doctor). Location & Schedule: Forest Rd (2nd Floor) Tuesday - Friday; Bakertown (3rd Floor) Sunday only. Strict Scheduling Rules & Limitations: PCP for all Internal Medicine patients. All Annual Physical (PE) & New Patient appointments must be 30 minutes regardless of patient age. Tuesdays are dedicated exclusively to his Sleep Medicine specialty practice (requires referral).

Specialist Provider: Dr. Francis Murphy (Dermatology). Schedule & Location: Forest Rd (2nd Floor), Every Thursday & Alternate Mondays. Duration: Office Visit 10 min; Procedures 30-40 min. Insurance & Scheduling Mandates: UHC Referral Mandate: Online referral required for United Healthcare patients before scheduling. Procedure Days Booking: Only book 1:40 PM and 2:30 PM slots; first post-lunch slot is 1:40 PM (not 1:30 PM). Strict 10-minute grace period for late arrivals. Route TEs directly to Dr. Murphy.

Specialist Provider: Dr. David Coven (Cardiology). Schedule & Location: Forest Rd (2nd Floor), Every Wednesday & Occasional Sundays. Duration: Age <65 is 15 min; Age 65+ is 30 min. Insurance & Scheduling Mandates: NO MVP INSURANCE: Does not accept MVP; patient must be informed of $100 self-pay fee at booking. No referral required for internal cardiology booking.

Specialist Provider: Dr. Samuel Rosenberg (Pain Management). Schedule & Location: Forest Rd (2nd Floor), Every Tuesday. Duration: Evaluation 30 min; Follow-up 15-30 min. Insurance & Scheduling Mandates: Referral Mandatory for all patients. Outside referrals: Office notes, referral, and relevant imaging must be in chart prior to booking. Route TEs directly to Dr. Rosenberg.

Specialist Provider: Dr. Neil Shinder (Sleep Medicine). Schedule & Location: Forest Rd (2nd Floor), Every Tuesday. Duration: Evaluation 30 min; Follow-up 15 min. Insurance & Scheduling Mandates: Referral Mandatory for all initial evaluations. MANDATORY PATIENT REMINDER: All follow-up patients must be instructed to bring their CPAP machine to the visit.

Specialist Provider: Esther Taub (Nutritionist). Schedule & Location: Forest Rd (2nd Floor), By Appointment. Duration: Initial Consult 30-60 min; Follow-up 30 min. Insurance & Scheduling Mandates: Referral Mandatory for all patients. Chaperone Policy: A female companion must accompany all male patients or male minors under 18. Contact Esther directly via Teams for scheduling/tele-visits (TEs rarely sent).

Visit Type: Annual Physical (PE). Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 30 min (Age >27 or Dr. Shinder); 15 min (Age <=26 non-Shinder). Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: For Medicare patients, set appointment reason strictly to 'Medicare PE' to trigger appropriate clinical/nursing protocols.

rules.duration_rules: 30 min if Age >27 or Dr. Shinder; 15 min if Age <=26 non-Shinder

content: Visit Type: Evening Physicals. Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: Follows PE rules (until 8:00 PM). Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: Offered by Adam Tilson, Naftali Minzer, and Myer Gurkov. Available strictly for patients 40 years old and younger. No CDL exams permitted.

Visit Type: New Patient (NP). Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 30 minutes. Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: Defined as not seen in Adult Medicine within the past 3 years. Adam Tilson does NOT see new patients over 60-65.

rules.definition: Not seen in Adult Medicine within past 3 years

content: Visit Type: Same-Day Sick Visit. Pre-Bookable: NO (Same-Day Only). Duration: 15 minutes. Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: For acute symptoms. Age range: 18-65. Cannot be pre-booked in advance.

Visit Type: Routine Office Visit (OV). Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 15 minutes (30 min for 65+ / chronic). Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: For non-acute follow-ups, minor complaints, or in-person referral requests.

Visit Type: ER Follow-Up (ER F/U). Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 30 minutes. Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: Hospital records mandatory prior to booking. Send TE to PSS Queue with hospital details to obtain records before scheduling.

rules.prerequisite: Hospital records mandatory prior to booking via PSS Queue TE

content: Visit Type: Pre-Operative Clearance. Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 30 minutes. Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: Advise booking 30 days prior to surgery. Advise labs take 5-7 days. Verify PE is up to date and document 'Physical UTD' in appointment reason.

Visit Type: CDL Exam. Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 30 minutes. Operational Rules & ECW Documentation: Naftali Minzer only (max 2/day). If PE is UTD (<1 yr): book 30-min OV. If PE overdue: book PE and note 'CDL' in reason. Dr. Derman patients pay $100 self-pay fee.

Visit Types: 1) Suture Removal: Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 15 minutes. Adult/Internal Medicine routinely performs suture removal; advise callers not to delay removal and book promptly. 2) Tele-Visit: Pre-Bookable: With Approval. Duration: Per Provider. Requires provider authorization before booking; do not schedule without confirmation.

Service: Blood Work / Labs. Slot Duration: 20 minutes. Prerequisites: Active orders from internal provider on chart. Key Workflow & Booking Guidelines: Location Mandate: Book at Forest Rd (Bakertown lab is not fully staffed). Must have existing lab order (includes Behavioral Health); if no order exists, book PCP Office Visit first. Set ordering provider as appointment provider so results route back properly.

Nurse Services: 1) Diabetic Injections (Ozempic, Mounjaro): Nurse Visit; requires medication ordered by clinic provider; patient must bring their own medication to the clinic. 2) PPD Plant & Read (TB Screening): 15 min Nurse schedule; PE must be up to date; Follow-up 'Read' appointment must be booked strictly between 48 and 72 hours after initial 'Plant'. 3) COVID-19 Testing: Asymptomatic (Travel/Pre-op) -> 15-min Nurse visit for PCR (results in 48-72 hrs); Symptomatic -> Must be evaluated by a provider, book standard Office Visit (NOT nurse visit). 4) Flu & Routine Injections (B12, Shingrix): 5-15 min Nurse schedule; order on file required; Flu shots Mon-Thu 1:00 PM-4:00 PM with Adam Tilson, PA listed as appointment provider; routine 5-min injection slots can be double-booked.

Referrals, Insurance & Prior Authorizations Workflow: Referral Specialist: Anisa Azeez handles general Adult Medicine referral routing. Online Insurance Referrals (e.g., United Healthcare - UHC): 1) Identify Specialty. 2) Check eCW Outgoing Referrals to verify if Adult Medicine provider previously placed referral in chart. 3) If Referral Exists in Chart: Create TE to Adult Med PSS Queue with Specialist Full Name, Appointment Address, Appointment Date. 4) If NO Referral Exists in Chart: If PE Up to Date & Seen Recently -> Check if nurse approves referral, send TE to nurse with details and add note: 'If added in eCW, please forward TE to Jubilee for online submission.' If PE Up to Date BUT Not Seen in a Few Months -> Advise patient an Office Visit (OV) is required. If PE Overdue -> Patient must schedule an Annual Physical (PE) before referral can be generated. 5) Urgent Requests: Contact Jubilee Aviles (Primary) or Viviana Molano (Secondary).

CRITICAL ROUTING RULE: Medication Prior Authorizations and 2020 Transportation Forms must be sent to the PSS Queue, NOT the Nursing Queue. 1) AMED_Nursing Queue: Medication refill requests (PE must be UTD; High Priority if completely out -> Subject line: 'RX refill - all out'; Standard Priority if 2-3 days left; include exact drug name, dosage, prescribing doctor, pharmacy info), Clinical questions & triage, Requests to speak with a provider, Referral requests (internal clinical review), Lab results inquiries (Black Lock). 2) AMED_PSS Queue: Medication Prior Authorizations (handled by PSS team / Viviana), Medicaid Transportation (2020 Forms), Requests to mail/email labs, records, or forms, Online insurance referrals (UHC submission), ER records requests before booking ER follow-ups. 3) Direct Provider TEs: Send directly to provider ID in eCW for Dr. Francis Murphy (Dermatology clinical questions) and Dr. Samuel Rosenberg (Pain Management clinical questions).

entity: Former Patients of Dr. Derman Medication Refills
content: Medication Refills for Former Patients of Dr. Derman: 1) Establish Care Required: Former patients must schedule an appointment with a new Aizer PCP. 2) Bridge Refills (Non-Controlled): If scheduled with an Aizer provider, request a bridge refill to cover medication until the appointment date. 3) Controlled Substances: Strictly require an in-person visit; no bridge refills permitted. 4) TE Workflow: Once visit is booked, route TE to Emely Espinosa, who queues the exact days required and routes to provider for sign-off.

1) Medicaid Transportation (2020 Forms): Managed by Viviana Molano via the PSS Queue. Prerequisites: Verify patient has an active Annual PE and an existing referral on file for the destination specialist. Collect specialist full name, specialty, address, and appointment date before submitting. 2) HIPAA & Consent Verification Protocol: NPP (New Patient Packet): Signed once upon clinic entry. HIPAA Privacy Consent: Signed annually. AM MRC (Adult Medicine Medical Release Consent): Signed annually to authorize record retrieval. ECW Documentation: In Appointment General Notes, list any missing forms due; if all forms are current, type: 'AF COMP [Your Initials]'.
